executive_summary: The broader equity market has staged a powerful relief rally led by a massive surge in artificial intelligence and tech shares, catalyzed by Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia. While macroeconomic concerns persist around Strait of Hormuz oil tanker disruptions and widening U.S. sanctions, equity indexes posted their best sessions in over a year as investor confidence in AI infrastructure spending was fully restored.

recommendations.catalyst: Jensen Huang unanimously reinstated as CEO, removing the recent executive uncertainty and restoring AI trade conviction.
recommendations.strategy: Scale in on minor pullbacks; maintain a core long position given restored governance stability and government-backed assurances.
recommendations.risk: Governance concentration risk around founder reliance and heightened regulatory/geopolitical scrutiny.
